title: Main bootstrap for canonical Hostinger Tenant Canary evidence

phases.objective: Register the read-only Tenant Canary pull-request workflow on main and prove its exact-head producer-to-publisher handshake without promoting Spec 014 runtime modules or migrations.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The main-registered Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard definition and static bootstrap contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A qualifying pull request can be checked out at its exact head, execute the candidate-owned canonical runner, upload one run-bound secret-free artifact, and hand the same exact-head evidence to the trusted main-based publisher.
steps: Validate the permanent pull-request workflow is registered under the exact Hostinger Tenant Canary name.
Require narrow Tenant Canary path filters instead of repository-wide JavaScript or TypeScript globs.
Require contents:read only, exact candidate checkout, persisted credentials disabled, and local/remote SHA equality.
Require execution of the candidate-owned canonical Tenant Canary runner and upload of the run-bound JSON and Markdown artifact.
Validate fail-closed contract, candidate SHA, counts, integrity findings, no-secret declaration, no-log decision, and no-mutation/provider/credential declarations.
Validate the trusted workflow_run publisher and routing registry consume the same workflow name, artifact identity, canonical contract, and exact head.
assertions: The bootstrap contains no Hostinger runtime module, provider adapter, migration, SQL, route mount, credential, or deployment implementation.
The PR-head workflow has contents:read only and no issue, pull-request, action, or repository write permission.
The workflow checks out and verifies the exact pull-request head before executing candidate-owned tests.
The artifact name is bound to github.run_id and missing files fail closed.
The trusted publisher remains checked out from main and is the only component with bounded comment-write authority.
The routing registry binds candidate_kind=head, mad4b.hostinger-guard-summary.v1, and the exact Hostinger publisher identity.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and all structured evidence declares secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Observe the first real exact-head Tenant Canary run on the Spec 014 Integration pull request and verify run-bound artifact publication through the trusted publisher.
Exercise missing runner output, malformed JSON, stale remote head, cancelled runs, artifact absence, and publisher retry behavior while preserving fail-closed decisions.
Record the first authoritative Hostinger Tenant Canary section on the shared canonical pull-request comment for the exact Integration head.
This CI bootstrap grants no Hostinger, provider, migration, deployment, Production, or protected-branch mutation authority.
